notes.title: A whole household is baptised
notes.intro: The Philippian jailer and his household are baptised at once.

views.label: Supports baptising children with their parents
views.summary: Those who baptise infants note that whole households, presumably including children, were baptised.

views.label: Those baptised had heard and believed
views.summary: Others note that the household heard the word and believed (vv. 32, 34), so it does not prove infants were baptised.
views.source: Baptist Faith and Message (2000), Article VII
